articles.title: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum is preparing its 'biggest rebuild' since the Merge
articles.snippet: A revised roadmap details how the multi-year overhaul would replace nearly every major part of Ethereum's protocol, with quantum resistance and privacy moving up the priority list. It lands as ether rallies more than 12% in the past seven days.

articles.title: Ethereum 'Reinventing Itself' With Biggest Overhaul Since the Merge: Vitalik Buterin
articles.snippet: Nearly every core piece of the protocol will be rebuilt over three to four years, with quantum safety and privacy moved front and center.

articles.title: What Is Q-Day? The Quantum Threat to Bitcoin Explained
articles.snippet: Experts warn quantum computers could someday forge Bitcoin’s digital signatures, allowing unauthorized transactions.
